6.301 rsInvalidObjectNameNotUnique
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
rsInvalidObjectNameNotUnique is a critical error that will occur when an element within a collection in
a GaugePanel or Chart element does not have a Name attribute with a unique or non-null value. For
example, this error will occur if there exist two RadialPointer elements with their Name attribute set
to "myRadialPointer" within the same RadialPointers collection.
